summary: The author describes a multi-agent 'harness' architecture in which specialized agents coordinate in parallel, persist context across sessions, and use isolated worktrees for sub-agent work.

practices.reason: Describes a concrete multi-agent coordination pattern with persistent context and isolated worktrees that a team could consider implementing, though no gain is quantified.
practices.quote: the harness architecture: multiple specialized agents coordinate in parallel on the same task. they persist across your session, building context instead of starting cold each time. for complex work, sub-agents fan out into isolated worktrees so your working copy stays clean.
